lines: 「Ultimate Skill: Double Illusion Blade!! Take this!!」
The one who had attacked first was Tomoe.

Hers was a special technique, in which she fired a “blade” of pure bloodthirst at the outset, creating the illusion of a slash attack, and then unleashed a deadly blow upon the enemy while they were distracted by that.
His metal club roared through the air.
Benkei tried to counter the illusion of the slash attack, and then
As soon as he realized that it was an illusion, without the slightest bit of negligence, he knocked down the deadly blow from Tomoe that followed it.
「Consecutive attacks, projecting your bloodthirst as bait, huh? To think you would pull a cheap trick like that out of nowhere. Child's play, typical for a woman!」
「You disappoint me. Is this what Taimanin are like? I shall exemplify a real combo attack for you!」
He swung his metal club downwards.
His fighting aura formed a shockwave that surged towards Tomoe.
Her blade flew out of its scabbard like the wind.
Tomoe struck down the shockwave head-on, but
Having charged forward as if chasing after it, Benkei had entered striking range of her.
It was unbelievable movement for his huge body.
She didn't even have time to reorient her sword.
Benkei was about to deal her a fatal blow, when that instant,
A tremendous shower of sparks flew around.
Lena had forced her way in between them, and slammed Sakura Blossom against the metal club from the side.
He immediately thrust at her with the club she had deflected.
Lena whirled gracefully through the air to dodge that, then
Transformed the cloud of dust she had kicked up with her sword into cherry blossoms, and blinded Benkei's eyes.
Taking advantage of that opportunity, she and Tomoe quickly pulled back.
「It's a repayment for saving me before!」
「Fuhahahaha!! A flower petal smokescreen! Isn't that elegant?! Well done, well done!!」
There was no sign that he even minded.
He was roaring with laughter, enveloped by the fluttering cherry blossom petals.
「Then, in that case, how about this?! Wind God: Slashing Wind Barrage!!」
It wasn't like Asuka had just been watching in silence.
She mercilessly hurled her whirlwind art at Benkei, who was enjoying himself, surrounded by the petals.
In accordance with Asuka's rage, more violent vacuum blades than before enveloped him.
Benkei held the middle of his metal club, and began to spin it around over his head like an electric fan.
Wind broke out through sheer brute force.
It was wind going in the opposite direction from her cutting whirlwind.
He was cancelling out her vacuum blades with that.
「Marvellous! It's been a long time since something made me shed blood. I've started wanting your head all the more.」
There was a little blood rushing out from his cheek, but it was only a scratch.
「What kind of responsiveness does this guy have......?」
Despite talking flippantly, Asuka was shuddering.
She had never seen such a forceful way of thwarting that.
It looked like the rumours that he had brought down one famous cyborg after another were no mistake.
「First off, one thing. You've entertained me well.」
「However, I'd like you to show me that impudent cyborg strength now.」
Benkei was looking at them with plenty of composure.
His face said that he was looking forward to the trio's next move, especially Asuka's.
（Cyborg strength... If I could use that, there'd be no trouble!）
Despite grumbling in her mind, she approached Lena and Tomoe.
「Yeah. But he's a formidable man. On top of suddenly seeing through my technique, that movement... It's not humanly possible.」
「It was all I could do, just to put up the smokescreen. That guy has no openings at all.」
「I can't believe my Arts would be beaten by such ridiculous means, either.」
「Usually, I have Android Arms and Legs, so I'd have other ways of doing things too.」
Well, Asuka supposed a flesh-and-blood person probably wouldn't think of having limbs for everyday use and combat use.
「They don't have weapons. They're purely high-performance limbs.」
「Today, I really did just happen to come here, and just happen to get mistaken for someone else, and just happen to get attacked by guys like that.」
「S-Sorry...... I didn't think it would turn out like this......」
Lena was about to become downhearted again, but
「You can apologize later. Lena, I can't bring down that guy with my wind alone. Let's do it with two people's worth!」
「In that case, I'll buy you time.」
The Taimanin also took that job on.
「Now then, lady warriors. Have you decided your strategy? Try and amuse me as best you can!」
Benkei struck the ground with the bottom of his metal club, as if to say time was up.
「The three of us are going to crush that arrogance!!」
Tomoe, whose job was to stall for time, charged at him.
Asuka and Lena readied their wind skills in sync.
The air surrounding the two of them began to form a vortex, slowly but powerfully.
Tomoe unleashed attacks that didn't even give him time to breathe.
They were chain attacks which made the blade of her sword look like streaks of light.
For the sake of buying time, she was purposely engaging in close-quarters fighting, rather than using the quick-draw attack she specialized in.
Violent sparks flew between her and Benkei.
At first glance, it looked as though Tomoe was in the advantageous position.
But that was not the case.
「Quite excellent swordsmanship! But at the end of the day, you have the delicate arms of a woman! Too soft!!」
He was stopping every one of the slash attacks that were being incessantly unleashed.
「Now, shall we get to my turn?!」
As soon as Benkei launched his attack, she was put on the back foot in the blink of an eye.
「Why don't you put more spirit into it? You're going to make that longsword cry!」
The metal club that he swung around effortlessly repelled Tomoe's sword from both sides.
Even though Benkei was clearly holding back, it was all she could do to defend.
It was a situation where she was only narrowly dodging—no, being allowed to dodge.
Shouted the Hell Knight, out of concern for her comrade.
She seemed like she was about to run in there at any time, even though their wind hadn't fully risen yet.
This was the time to bear with it.
「You're still too green to challenge me!!」
The metal club made a tremendous roar.
Unable to stop Benkei's strike completely, Tomoe's posture bent far out of shape.
「I shall grant you the peace and tranquility of nirvana!!」
His metal club was raised overhead.
Just before the finishing blow was struck,
All of a sudden, Benkei's back was sliced diagonally.
Yamada showed himself, having undone his optical camouflage.
After all, he had been watching in hiding all this time, waiting for the right moment to come out.
Since he had called out to Asuka earlier, in the airport, she had figured it would probably be the same this time as well.
「Unnnnnngh!! Not even showing yourself until now, and from behind...! Are you a cyborg as well?!!」
Benkei had a furious, oni-like expression.
The wound on his back was by no means shallow. It looked as though his rage was surpassing the pain of that.
「I am named Yamada Tarou. Pleased to make your acquaintance, though I expect only for a short time.」
Without minding at all, Yamada was greeting him perfectly normally, with a face which looked like he was about to hand over his business card or something.
Benkei forgot about Tomoe entirely, and tried to attack Yamada in anger.
She unleashed an ultra-high-speed quick-draw attack.
A telekinetic secret sword technique passed down through her clan.
That slashed through precisely the same spot on his back that Yamada had made his surprise attack on.
Blood jetted out from his back like a water fountain.
Even Benkei fell to his knees on the spot.
The two people's worth of wind had risen to the max.
His movements had stopped as well.
The huge vacuum tornado that Asuka had unleashed
And the raging storm of cherry blossom blades that Lena had kicked up
Engulfed Benkei through the synergy of their two winds.
He couldn't move even a step.
He could do nothing but have his body cut apart in the middle of the huge, hellish tornado.
The tornado became coloured bright red.
Benkei's figure was gradually whittled away, mixing in with the blood and gore flying around, and became unrecognizable.
The man with the nickname of the Cyborg Hunter had met his end torn to pieces, just like the cyborgs he had destroyed.
「Well, it wasn't all fair and square, though, was it?」
「That guy was the one who said “Come at me all at once.” There's nothing to be ashamed of.」
Lena had also sheathed Sakura Blossom in its scabbard.
Tomoe approached the two of them.
「A united front between a Hell Knight, a Taimanin and the DSO, huh? Ingrid-sama'll be amazed when she hears about this. But we were a good combination, weren't we?」
Tomoe seemed a little conflicted, but she bowed her head deeply again towards the two of them.
「I'm truly sorry that I did something like that to you two before, because of my own misunderstanding.」
「Nah, don't worry about it. Today's been nothing but misunderstandings.」
「We couldn't have won if you weren't there, right? I'll even forgive you for cutting my hair.」
「But how did you know it was a misunderstanding?」
Tomoe turned around and looked at Yamada.
He had retracted his arm blades, and was making a casual-looking face at a distance from the three of them.
「I figured it was something like that.」
Lena was cocking her head at the sighing Asuka.
「Oh, right. Lena doesn't know his face. He's the dimwit information dealer who mistook me for you.」
「Wha?! So you were the cause of all this?!」
「I do apologize. But I'm not the original cause, you know?」
「You are also at fault for not showing up at the appointed time.」
「Ugh...... That's true, but I went through an awful time thanks to you!!」
「So, after all this, what's the data? This thing's the cause of all this turmoil, so please just tell us.」
Asuka asked, taking out the usual memory card.
Lena was still keeping silent, after all that.
「I like you well enough, but if it's the sort of thing that'll bring turmoil to the world, I can't afford to hand it over.」
「Me neither. I may have fought alongside you today, but you're a Nomad Hell Knight. As a Taimanin, there are some things I can't overlook.」
Lena shouted, being pressed for answers by the other two.
The dealer, Yamada, sent her a lifeboat.
「I could tell them, but at this point, wouldn't it be better for you to be honest?」
He urged, at which point, looking like she had finally resigned herself, Lena said,
「I-I said...... it's private...... information and stuff...... about Ingrid-sama...... That sort of thing......」
「Ingrid is your superior, right? Why would you want that data?」
「I want to give Ingrid-sama a present of some kind.」
「But I don't know what kind of things she likes, and Ingrid-sama doesn't talk about herself much, so...... that's why I......」
She was making a face like that of a junior student who idolized a senpai in her club.
「So you tried to get data on your boss? I'm surprised.」
However, Asuka had also come here today to buy a present for Madam.
Though they may have been on different sides, she certainly felt a sense of kinship with Lena, who was doing something similar.
Yet there was a part she still couldn't understand.
「But why was that cyborg squad even going so far as to destroy the airport to try and get a hold of that?」
Lena looked at Yamada as if to say, 「Do you?」
「Yes. At the very least, it doesn't have anything whatsoever that you people from the DSO or the Taimanin would be concerned about. I couldn't take that kind of risk.」
「We'll just have to check the contents, won't we?」
Ignoring the panicking Lena, Asuka handed the memory card over to Yamada.
「Could you show me a little bit?」
He took the memory card, and opened its contents on his phone.
「These are the contents?! What is this?!!」
It was a series of photographs of Ingrid, which, to all appearances, had been taken with a hidden camera.
The ones of her fighting with a sword, Asuka could understand.
However, there were also a lot of private photos that were not very Hell Knight-like, of her in formalwear, swimsuits, and so forth.
Before Asuka could say anything, Lena was prattling on and on.
「Th-There was no other way!! Ingrid-sama doesn't like having her picture taken either!!」
「Even when I take one occasionally, her expression stiffens up immediately!」
「I mean, see, look at this, and this! She's so natural and gallant and cool!」
「I-I admire Ingrid-sama from the bottom of my heart!」
「I wanted these kind of photos!! There was no choice!!」
Asuka was flabbergasted by Lena, who insisted that, turning red from ear to ear.
「I don't care about that. I don't get in the slightest why they were trying to steal this......」
「Th-That's enough now, right? Give me back the memory card!」
Lena held her hand out embarrassedly, yet emphatically.
「I owe nothing to any senior executive of Nomad, but I wonder if it's really okay to hand this over?」
「Wh-Why not?! If you're gonna say that, I'll let this sword speak for me!!」
She laid her hand on her sword again, and Asuka coldly retorted,
「I'll reveal to Ingrid that you wanted these sneak shots.」
Tomoe, who had been keeping silent all this time, suddenly interjected.
「See? This girl says it's terrible too.」
「Wrong! You're the one who's terrible, Asuka-san!」
「I get it, Lena-san! I understand your feelings really well!!」
「I also revere my combat instructor, Hasuma-sensei, from the bottom of my heart!」
「I'm working hard every day to get closer to Sensei, to become a model Taimanin like her!」
「If there were wonderful photos of a person like that, it's only natural that you'd want them, isn't it?!!」
For some reason, they were acting like kindred spirits.
「Eeeeehhh?!! You guys are kinda weird! Don't you think this is bad for Ingrid?」
「It's not bad! It's not bad at all!」
「I don't want to be told that by stalkers!」
「Dear, dear, this is quite a fix.」
「Don't talk like it's someone else's problem!」
Asuka's troubles, which had started with a case of mistaken identity, showed no sign of ending yet.
In the end, the matter had been settled with the photographic data on Ingrid being handed over to Lena, and Asuka also keeping a copy of it.
And then, Asuka ended up being told off by Madam again.
「I can't take this anymore! Come on!!!」
